summary: All 14 discovered candidate interactions resolved to status=verified (9 ENGINE_EXACT/ENGINE_COMPONENT-tier, 5 RULES_VERIFIED with conditional=true for the Smothering Tithe group + Oboro/Talon Gates/Cradle at RULES_VERIFIED/conditional=false). INT-0001/0004/0005 re-derived from primary Oracle text (not Spellbook paraphrase): all require opponents declining Smothering Tithe's tax (conditional:true) and are mana-neutral at Spellbook's stated opponent-count minimum, strictly mana-positive only at 3+ opponents (INT-0001's real threshold is 3, not Spellbook's stated 2). INT-0006 similarly corrected: mana-neutral at Spellbook's stated 5-creature threshold (net = creatures-5), needs 6+ creatures for genuine accumulating mana; the 5-creature threshold does support infinite (free) landfall/phase-out repetition, just not infinite mana.
impact: Resolved - no remaining unverified candidate interactions block Gate 1.

summary: INT-0011's original candidate writeup claimed Derevi's combat-damage untap trigger 'scales with attacker count' (N connecting creatures -> N independent untap-then-retap cycles on Gaea's Cradle). Only the single-attacker base case was engine-verified; a two-attacker extension test failed ('Can't find available command - manaActivate' on the second retap, suggesting the second trigger's untap did not take effect as sequenced) and was not resolved within the session's effort budget for that interaction.
impact: The multi-attacker scaling claim is downgraded to 'plausible per the underlying rules mechanism (CR 603.2c, 603.3b, 117.3b), not itself engine-verified' in interactions/verified/INT-0011.json - it must not be treated as confirmed until a working multi-attacker test exists.

summary: User audit of commit 51bd25f (SIM-0013) found two problems with INT-0012: (1) a factual rules-text error claiming Clever Impersonator's own text says it 'becomes an artifact in addition to its other types' - it does not, the Artifact type comes entirely from copying Birthing Pod's own copiable Artifact type per CR 707.2; (2) a validation-standard issue - the executable-engine test reproduces only a downstream consequence (two literal Birthing Pod permanents, each independently activatable) rather than Clever Impersonator's own copy transition, but the record had been marked status=verified without distinguishing that from an exact reproduction.
impact: INT-0012 was overclaiming its own evidentiary strength - a future consumer could not tell, from status=verified alone, that this interaction's exact named transition had not itself been engine-reproduced.

summary: Final bounded interaction-discovery sweep (per autonomous-mode directive) targeting Survival of the Fittest, Deathrite Shaman, Minamo, Shifting Woodland, Enduring Vitality, Badgermole Cub, and remaining Delney/Kinnan/copy-target space.

Minamo+Gaea's Cradle (bounded, once-per-turn untap, not infinite by itself) and Enduring Vitality (grants creatures a mana ability, a synergy not a discrete new interaction) reviewed and deliberately deferred as low-impact per charter guidance - logged here, not separately validated. Survival of the Fittest and Deathrite Shaman confirmed (earlier this session) to have zero Spellbook-indexed combos and no material new interaction found on review.

summary: sim/rules_engine/ had no general Python orchestration adapter (decklist in, game log out). Built one: sim/rules_engine/xmage_adapter/ (deck_to_dck.py + run_diagnostic_game.py + SubjectDeckDiagnosticGameTest.java), driving real AI-vs-AI games (ComputerPlayer7) through a prepared XMage checkout, hash-verified against the frozen decklist, with machine-readable JSON transcripts.
impact: Ran 7 real diagnostic games (results/diagnostic/) - 4x 2-player Commander Duel, 3x 4-player Commander FFA - and reviewed every event against the full defect checklist. Zero rules-correctness defects found. One adapter bug found and fixed (seed applied too late, see INFRA-0005 for the residual AI-nondeterminism part). 4-player AI reliability issue found and scoped, not fixed - see INFRA-0006.

summary: Re-running the diagnostic game driver with the same --diag.seed does not reproduce an identical game line-for-line, even after fixing the seed-applied-too-late bug (moved RandomUtil.setSeed to @BeforeClass, confirmed the opening shuffle IS now seed-controlled). ComputerPlayer7's simulation-based decision search appears to have its own internal nondeterminism (likely hash-iteration-order or thread-scheduling dependent), independent of the shuffle RNG.
impact: Diagnostic game records retain their seed for provenance and the seed does fix the opening shuffle, but a past diagnostic game cannot currently be replayed bit-for-bit for deeper offline analysis of a specific line. Does not block SIMULATION_READY_DIAGNOSTIC-era diagnostics (each game is still independently valid evidence) or Gate 4 manual inspection (each game is inspected as it runs). Would need patching XMage's own AI search internals for full determinism - a large upstream change, not proportionate to this phase.

summary: ComputerPlayer7 (skill 6) is dramatically more passive in 4-player CommanderFreeForAll than in 2-player CommanderDuel. Two of three 4-player diagnostic games showed one or more seats taking zero actions (no land drops, no spells) across 5+ of their own turns, despite ~40% of the 98-card deck being lands - versus consistently active, sensible play (land drops, spells, fetches, attacks) in all four 2-player games tested.
impact: 4-player diagnostic games are not yet reliable evidence of engine/rules behavior beyond what 2-player games already cover, since so little actually happens. No rules-engine defect was found in the 4-player games either (all actions taken, however few, were legal) - this is a policy/AI-quality gap in the engine's own default AI at higher player counts, not a rules-correctness bug. Per explicit instruction, scoped rather than faked: the near-term Gate 4 manually-inspected batch should run as 2-player Commander Duel, where the AI substrate is demonstrably reliable; 4-player stays available but flagged lower-fidelity pending investigation (possible causes to check when revisited: simulation depth/time budget under larger branching factor, RangeOfInfluence.ALL interaction with the search, MultiplayerAttackOption handling).
